entities.name: PRDX1
observations: In PDAC cells, PRDX1 suppression decreased active p38 MAPK localized in protrusions and inhibited Matrigel invasion (PMID:25426613).

entities.name: p38 MAPK
observations: PRDX1 interacted with active p38 MAPK; PRDX1–phosphorylated-p38 complexes localized at leading edges of migrating PDAC cells. SB203580 reduced protrusions and invasion (PMID:25426613).

entities.name: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
observations: The PRDX1/p38 invasion mechanism was investigated in PDAC cells; PRDX1 overexpression was also reported in human PDAC tissues (PMID:25426613).

entities.name: PMID:25426613
observations: Taniuchi et al., Pancreas. 2015;44(2):331-340. DOI:10.1097/MPA.0000000000000270. PRDX1 suppression and p38 inhibition reduced PDAC cell protrusions and invasion.
